title: Nis2IncidentReporting
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — incident reporting obligations under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Defines the vocabulary for the multi-stage incident notification pipeline: early warning, formal notification, intermediate report, and final report. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: NIS2 Article 23.

reportingStage.description: Stage of the NIS2 incident reporting pipeline. EARLY_WARNING: within 24h, indicate if suspected unlawful/malicious and potential cross-border impact (Art 23(4)(a)). INCIDENT_NOTIFICATION: within 72h, update early warning with initial assessment including severity/impact (Art 23(4)(b)). INTERMEDIATE_REPORT: upon CSIRT request, relevant status updates (Art 23(4)(c)). FINAL_REPORT: within 1 month, detailed description including root cause, mitigation, cross-border impact (Art 23(4)(d)).

deadlineHours.description: Deadline in hours from incident awareness. EARLY_WARNING: 24. INCIDENT_NOTIFICATION: 72. FINAL_REPORT: 720 (1 month). INTERMEDIATE_REPORT: on demand (no fixed deadline).

recipientAuthority.description: Authority to which the report must be submitted. CSIRT: Computer Security Incident Response Team designated under Art 10. COMPETENT_AUTHORITY: national authority designated under Art 8. Source: NIS2 Art 23(1).

significantIncident.description: Whether the incident is classified as significant under Art 23(3): (a) caused or capable of causing severe operational disruption or financial loss, or (b) affected or capable of affecting other natural or legal persons by causing considerable material or non-material damage.

crossBorderImpact.description: Whether the incident has or may have cross-border impact. Source: NIS2 Art 23(4)(a).
